_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The mixed signals suggest a cautious optimism phase is approaching, and the narrative of market denial points towards a potential phase shift towards Hope.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes, both experts agree on the next phase.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed index crosses 71 with ETF flows above 75 and VIX below 18
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed index drops below 55 with DXY above 105 and VIX above 25
